inv and eq are separate item lists; rp, bp, qv, afi and spellbook semantics are explicit unsupported boundaries for this native compiler.

GUI layout and bank tags are outside the exact-counts preparation policy. Offline compilation does not prove gameplay execution of every imported setup; that uses the existing owned-loadout qualification and per-job Native/live acceptance.
